tiles.label: Active services (last 15m)
tiles.dql: timeseries total = sum(dt.service.request.count, scalar:true), by:{dt.entity.service}, from:-15m | filter total > 0 | summarize service_count = count()

tiles.label: Overall error rate (last 15m)
tiles.dql: timeseries { total = sum(dt.service.request.count, scalar:true), failed = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count, scalar:true) }, from:-15m | fieldsAdd error_rate_pct = if(total > 0, (failed / total) * 100, else: 0) | fields error_rate_pct

tiles.label: Failed requests (last 15m)
tiles.dql: timeseries failed = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count, scalar:true), from:-15m | fields failed

tiles.label: Error rate by service (last 15m)
tiles.dql: timeseries { total = sum(dt.service.request.count), failed = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count) }, by:{dt.entity.service}, from:-15m | fieldsAdd requests = arraySum(total), failed_requests = arraySum(failed) | filter requests > 0 | fieldsAdd error_rate_pct = (failed_requests / requests) * 100 | fieldsAdd service = entityName(dt.entity.service) | fields service, requests, failed_requests, error_rate_pct | sort error_rate_pct desc, requests desc | limit 200
